thread:
sam: Morning team  final prelaunch checklist for Webinar + three launch posts. Need: small KW set, JSON-LD (Event + 1 FAQ), internal-link map (pillar -> landing), redirect rules that keep UTMs/fragments, and inbound routing for register CTA. Owners by EOD?

jules: Ill own KW pruning and anchor copy. Will pick top 7 intent-driven keywords and add anchor suggestions. Sheet: tiny.example/kw-4167

paula: I can handle JSON-LD + FAQ and add a speaker entry. Will keep FAQ one short Q and validate injection in the landing branch.

ops-bot: scan: 3 pages missing Event structured data, 4 duplicate meta descriptions. Report: tiny.example/scan4167

sam: Paula, paste the JSON-LD you plan to use. Jules, paste anchor list and UTM template. Ops, propose nginx examples and smoke tests.

paula: JSON-LD draft (compact):
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"WebPage","name":"Webinar: Serving LLMs Efficiently","mainEntity":{"@type":"Event","name":"Serving LLMs Efficiently","startDate":"2026-03-26T17:00:00Z","url":"https://redwood.example/webinars/serving-efficiently","performer":{"@type":"Person","name":"Ravi Patel"}},"@graph":[{"@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"Who should attend?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Platform and ML engineers running inference at scale."}}]}]}
```

jules: Anchors: "inference latency", "LLM serving patterns", "optimize per-token cost". UTM template: ?utm_source=article&utm_medium=internal_link&utm_campaign=serving_launch. I'll add 3 contextual links from pillar -> landing and 1 from docs.

ops-bot: nginx examples (keep query/fragments):
```
# preserve qs
rewrite ^/old-paths/webinar/?$ /webinars/serving-efficiently? permanent;
location = /resources/webinar { return 301 /webinars/serving-efficiently; }
```

Smoke tests: curl -I check for 301, verify rel=canonical on landing, spot-check GA event on register CTA. Canary first, rollback instructions in PR.

sam: Good. Routing: default register CTA -> MA form. If company size >250 (from company field) route to SDR queue. We'll use zapier rule: enterprise_email domains -> SDR.

paula: I'll push JSON-LD + FAQ to the landing branch and add a unit test to assert JSON-LD injection and valid schema.

jules: I'll insert anchors into pillar content within first 500 words and add the inline CTA module. Also adding alt anchor wording for A/B.

sam: Timeline recap: redirects PR + smoke tests by 15:30, schema + unit tests by 16:30, KW + anchors locked by 17:00, messaging locked by 18:00, QA sign-off 20:00 PT. Go-live tomorrow 09:00 PT. Any blockers?

ops-bot: Recommendation: set rel=canonical on legacy pages to new landing after redirect and limit FAQ to one question. Also flag duplicate titles before deploy.

paula: No blockers from content.

jules: All good.

sam: Thanks team. Drop PR links here when ready and I'll coordinate the infra window. :rocket:
